title: Measure generated-control allocation and propose one bounded recovery slice
description: Design 66 R3. After workload validation, use diagnostic counters or allocator instrumentation in an isolated build to distinguish boxed Machine operands, visible Integers, literal Blocks, temporary Rust vectors and retained arenas. Compare iteration scales and default-GC versus no-GC, with captured callbacks. Current 100k-iteration no-GC sample peaks at 1.3 GiB; that is not evidence of a leak. Propose one measured optimization with reentry/rooting tests. Direct Machine slot access or Integer canonicalization requires an explicit semantic design decision under 60F and 60O. This issue is research/design, not authorization for that semantic change.
notes: Initial R2 full workload results/profile supplied the investigation prerequisite; relation is now related while R2 tracks final repeat acceptance. Full counter matrix and bounded inline-slot decision documented in Design66. Inline focused tests118 pass including million-step checks; private build done. Module/lifecycle checks session93074 and finalverify session51640 are running. Host-gated comparison session55231 is waiting for AC power; performance retention remains unproven.
close_reason: Full isolated counters and GC/capture/length matrix completed, raw logs and formulas recorded in Design66. Bounded inline-slot experiment rejected: retirement failure3/3 vs committedVec3/3 passes; no measured performance acceptance. Trial removed, production source restored exactly to ec281d1b. Decision retain three validated improvements and existing rooted invocation-owned Vecs; future scratch changes must satisfy quiescent reclamation. R2 still owns host-gated repetition/macro profile.

title: Reduce allocation registry metadata and index generated vtable cache
description: Follow-on evidence from Design 66 after Symbol indexing: empty-loop profile is dominated by Integer allocation and heap address-map insertion/rehash; generated vtable cache lookup is 126/2451 leaf samples and still scans a Vec. Evaluate removing redundant payload pointer from private heap records while deriving it from allocation base with provenance, and indexing generation/slot cache lookup without changing rooting, generation withdrawal/restoration or late binding. Keep changes only with tests plus measured runtime/memory benefit. No Integer canonicalization or Machine-send elimination.
notes: Prepared compact Block metadata and BTreeMap generation/slot cache pass cargo test --workspace --locked --offline. Release prefix /tmp/birnam-throughput.To6mYL/optimized built successfully. Control profile, allocation matrix, and full benchmark queued sequentially; lifecycle acceptance and measured retention decision still pending.
close_reason: Implemented in ec281d1b. Four-word heap Block metadata and generation/slot BTree cache preserve provenance and lifecycle ownership. Workspace and lifecycle gates pass. Combined full comparison improves docgen52.413s to43.808s and RSS433MiB to370MiB versus Symbol-only; loops improve further. No semantic sends removed or boxed values canonicalized. Repetition remains in R2.

title: Index weak Symbol lookup without changing identity or GC semantics
description: Implement Design 66 R1. Current isolated loop profile attributes 659/2484 leaf samples to Symbols::intern; symbol.rs scans ordered names linearly. Add a derived byte lookup index while preserving ordered enumeration, stable C-name pointers, arbitrary non-NUL bytes, weak reclamation, reinterning identity and compatibility limits. Cover compaction survivors/all-dead cycles/growth and collision handling. Benchmark hits and misses at multiple table sizes and run the same control probe plus relevant workspace, GC/image and lifecycle gates. Preserve late-bound Machine and source sends. Do not implement unrelated transport optimizations.
close_reason: Implemented in ec281d1b. Indexed weak collision-safe lookup preserves name ownership/enumeration and sweep semantics. Scaling diagnostic removes linear growth. Workspace tests, 611 module tests, control AOT/source, resumable/CodeBinding/image lifecycle, image-v8, bounded churn and project smoke pass. Full development comparison reports loop and docgen gains in Design66; R2 retains repetition/profile scope.

title: Validate Symbol-index payoff across loops, queries and documentation
description: Design 66 R2. After the Symbol index, compare independently built before/after release prefixes using full non-quick micro and relational suites plus docgen.full. Preserve loaded module sets, case order, result cardinalities, process isolation and raw timings. Alternate A/B order for small effects; retain the v0.14 baseline. Report workload-specific deltas and reprofile the loop and one slow macro. This supplies the evidence needed to select the next optimization and does not relax release thresholds.
notes: Macro profile completed on accepted c7170fdf prefix:2532 samples; free261,vtable lookup111,portable inspect110,store current-value104. Attribution only (battery), no timing median. R3 closed after counter matrix and rejected inline retirement regression. Accepted runtime ec281d1b restored exactly, full verify/lifecycle evidence remains valid. Sole remaining gate is host-checked reverse-order full comparison of optimized then originalpublication prefixes. Battery82% observed again; user asked to connect AC. No benchmark process left running.

title: Research and document stackless throughput recovery
description: After publication closeout, measure current loop/callback behavior and inspect execution, frame, and dispatch costs. Compare with retained v0.14 evidence without treating historical timings as current. Produce a repo-native plan with ranked hypotheses, bounded implementation slices, semantic/lifecycle gates, reproducible commands and follow-up Beads coverage. This task authorizes research and documentation, not throughput implementation.
close_reason: Research and Design 66 complete. Current quick micro suite and three fresh 100k-iteration loop probes completed; separate steady-state sample attributes 659/2484 leaf samples (26.5%) to linear Symbol interning and shows allocation pressure. Documented provenance, limits, source cost model, semantic/lifecycle gates and ordered follow-up issues: weak Symbol index, full workload validation, allocation investigation. Added reproducible timing/sampling probe; no throughput implementation performed.
